provenance.filter: a form is a member iff most of its tokens are UPOS PRON, most of its PRON tokens are third-person personal (Person=3, PronType=Prs), Sing outnumbers Plur among those, and the majority gender is Masc or Fem; no hand list
provenance.note: per-form shares: the sidecar *.shares.json; binds only with a recorded evaluation

evaluation.method: gold: CorefUD 1.3 French-Democrat dev (written French, 19th-21st c.), PROIEL-style definition as English GUM: PRON Person=3 Sing Prs Gender Masc/Fem whose entity has a proper-noun mention a cast span overlaps; the canonical read, default dials, register derived from UD French-GSD; development read (8 train documents): 0.703 at 42.6%; per form on the test: elle 30 right 13 wrong, il 10 right 21 wrong, le and la not in the register
